sentences.en: Television enables us to learn about foreign manners and customs.
sentences.zh: 电视让我们能够了解外国的风俗习惯。

sentences.en: We have to do away with such a bad custom.
sentences.zh: 我们必须摒弃这种不良的习惯。

sentences.en: The old custom is still kept up in that district.
sentences.zh: 在那个地区，这个古老的习俗仍然保留着。

senses.zh: 风俗，习俗；习惯；光顾，惠顾；<法律>惯例，习惯法；（经常性的）顾客
